audit.why: Tricky lane: her range wins 1-3, evens 4-6, she out-values grouped late, Swain wins via all-in/roam — 58.2% WR reflects that path; chart rows are hers early, not contradictory once full layer agrees.
Spikes: her 1-3 window, 4-5 even, 6 read, first item even, late Orianna — all present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five ability names miss the colon (Command Attack -> Command: Attack etc.); Orianna misgendered in 15 fields; cooldowns field with no digits; full phases[1-2].side say Skill while content and packet say Orianna.
audit.why: Riot's names are Command: Attack / Command: Protect / Command: Shockwave. Shockwave is 110/95/80s, her E shield 9s flat.
audit.corrected: Names, pronouns, numbers and chart agreement fixed.
